title: Correctness of the selected source action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. The action selected from the state of $c$ and the payload vector centered at offset $0$ equals the totalized action of $M$ at $c$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite machine over Booleans
c is a configuration of M on x
replaced:
For every binary machine $M$ and every configuration $c$ of $M$ on an input $x$, the
action selected by the data controller from the control state of $c$ and the
head-centered payloads at offset $0$ equals the totalized action of $M$ at $c$.
